entry.note: Identified from the arXiv title page (arXiv:2305.07425v1, math.GT, dated 15 May 2023): Abbott, Nguyen, Rasmussen, 'Largest hyperbolic actions of 3-manifold groups', 20 pp. No ref() entry, none created (tangential).

relevance.rationale: Geometric group theory of 3-manifold groups: the poset of cobounded hyperbolic actions of π_1(M) (Abbott–Balasubramanya–Osin) and whether it has a largest element (H-accessibility). Read: Introduction (Thm 1.1 — a non-geometric 3-manifold whose JSJ decomposition contains a hyperbolic piece with a boundary torus of M, two hyperbolic pieces glued along a torus, an isolated non-elementary Seifert piece, or a non-elementary maximal graph-manifold component has H-inaccessible π_1; Cor 1.2(a) connected sums of cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds are H-inaccessible; Thm 1.3 non-elementary graph/Seifert manifolds; Thm 1.4 Croke–Kleiner admissible groups have an index ≤ 2 H-inaccessible subgroup; Cor 1.5) and §2.1 (H-accessibility). Corpus-grep, all four content/docs/beans surfaces: zero hits for 'hyperbolic action', 'H-accessib', 'acylindrical', 'hierarchically hyperbolic', 'Croke-Kleiner'. The folio's objects are single hyperbolic knot complements S^3 ∖ K (geometric, so outside Thm 1.1's non-geometric hypothesis) and its invariants come from the Hecke algebra / Markov trace and the NZ gluing data, never from group actions of π_1 on hyperbolic spaces; the one connection — that a hyperbolic group's largest action is its action on H^3 — is background the folio never invokes. Same broad field (3-manifold topology), no consumable result. Scope-(a): this document, as read, supplies nothing usable here; that is not a claim that geometric-group-theoretic invariants of knot groups are excluded from any future closure.
